I'm sorry your product arrived damaged. Unfortunately, order 1008 was placed 45 days ago, and our refund window is 30 days for paid orders, so I can't request a refund for it through the automatic system.

If you'd like, I can send your case to a human reviewer to look at the damage. Would you like me to do that? If so, please reply with any photos or details you have about the damage.
